summary: CLAIM C-0001: The exact method of lifting/moving blocks is genuinely unknown and contested; no consensus exists.
content: The precise construction method for lifting and placing the Great Pyramid's blocks is genuinely unknown and actively contested. No contemporary document from Khufu's time explains the technique (EV-0008). Multiple competing theories exist (external ramp, spiral ramp, internal ramp, levering, pulley/counterweight) with none conclusively proven (EV-0001, EV-0002, EV-0003, EV-0004, EV-0005, EV-0006). Even the most accepted ramp theory is acknowledged as incomplete and must be supplemented by another device (EV-0005).
